sections.title: The genus
sections.text: Pseudotsuga is a genus of evergreen conifers in the pine family, native to North America and East Asia. The most widely distributed species is Douglas-fir, P. menziesii; other species have much narrower ranges.

sections.title: Recognition
sections.text: Douglas-firs bear hanging seed cones with three-pointed bracts that project beyond the scales. This general plate is compatible with the genus but cannot identify a species by itself.
